title: "Sample size calculation: executable methods appendix"
format:

execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| output: asis
library(aiimsulator)

sample_size <- ss_proportion(
  p = 0.50,
  precision = 0.05,
  confidence = 0.95,
  nonresponse = 0.10
)

cat(ss_report(
  sample_size,
  formula = TRUE,
  substituted_values = TRUE,
  results = TRUE,
  assumptions = TRUE,
  references = TRUE,
  format = "markdown"
))
```

The final recruitment target was `r sample_size$n_final` participants.

```{r}
#| echo: false
knitr::kable(ss_table(sample_size), digits = 5,
             caption = "Intermediate calculations and recruitment count")
```
